patch_description: Restructure the algorithm as an explicit pipeline of independent, modular stages (`NodePacker`, `ExpertReplicator`, `GpuPacker`) orchestrated by a `RebalancePipeline` class. Each stage is decoupled: it receives immutable inputs and produces outputs, improving maintainability and allowing each stage to use the best-suited implementation. Key performance changes: (1) balanced_packing uses LPT with a per-pack capacity counter and heap, processing layers with pre-extracted Python lists to avoid tensor indexing overhead; (2) replicate_experts is rewritten with an iterative batched refinement that replicates greedily by per-replica load (weight/count), and (3) the final map construction uses a single scatter with flattened precomputed index tensors. The stage boundaries also make the global-vs-hierarchical policy selection a simple pipeline configuration rather than duplicated call paths.
